historical_reviews.deepseek: Its wildcard command broadens scope, may not address a literal '*' sensor, and does not preserve the exact raw 0x2D coverage.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly restores the source's selected-sensor command and adds semantic parsing.
historical_reviews.history: Reading factors, SDR identity and event-status records are complementary inputs; setters and re-arm commands remain out of scope.
historical_reviews.v3_1: The raw reading byte is not an engineering value until the matched SDR conversion and sensor availability flags have been applied.

original_test_intent: Read one verified sensor's current raw value and status over OOB, convert it with that sensor's SDR metadata, and report unavailable or event states without modifying the sensor.
original_method: Retain IPMI v2.0 Table 35-15 raw Sensor/Event 0x04/0x2D <sensor number>; reject the DeepSeek wildcard substitution and parse the complete response under the matched SDR.
manual_activity: Project supplies the approved sensor number, matched SDR, conversion model and expected operating range; ordinary read-only collection needs no interactive confirmation.
required_inputs: Matched SDR sensor type, unit, linearization and factors
Expected operating/threshold context and timestamp tolerance
safety_requirements: Do not broaden to wildcard sensor collection
Do not borrow factors from another sensor
Do not re-arm or change thresholds/event policy
agent_execution_scope: Verify BMC and bind the source sensor number to one SDR
Preserve the complete raw response and timestamp
Validate availability/scanning and decode sensor-specific state bits
Convert the reading only with the matched SDR
Compare with the approved operating and threshold context
engineer_actions: Approve sensor/SDR mapping and expected range
Review unavailable, disabled or out-of-range results

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek's sensor get '*' command is not an exact substitute for the source's one-sensor raw 0x2D request and can collect unrelated data; the fallback truncation also weakens identity evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use one secret-safe raw 0x04 0x2d <sensor number> request as defined by IPMI v2.0 Table 35-15; decode reading/status availability first, then convert the reading only with the matched SDR factors and units.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The source's OOB path, single sensor parameter and 10/5 timing are preserved; its log-clearing boilerplate is not executed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Capture one timestamped raw response, gate conversion on reading availability and scanning state, decode event bits through the SDR and retain both raw and engineering-unit values.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a semantic oracle and evidence contract without changing the source command or Master data.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: This does not enumerate sensors, validate conversion factors independently, change policy or prove event generation under stimulus.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: One snapshot may catch an update transition; unavailable state must be reported rather than hidden by retrying until a number appears.

project_override_considerations: A high-level sensor API is equivalent only if it selects the same sensor and exposes the raw reading, availability/scanning state, event bits, SDR identity and conversion inputs.
expected_evidence: Completion, response length, availability/scanning and state bits
Raw reading plus SDR conversion inputs
Decoded engineering value and threshold/context comparison

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The title and raw procedure consistently request one sensor reading. Generic command-success criteria and log clearing are incomplete acceptance/evidence practices, not contradictory source requirements; the wildcard mismatch belongs to the historical DeepSeek review rather than the Master source.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The read command and response model are defined. Sensor identity, SDR conversion and expected context are Project readiness inputs; malformed or unavailable results are preserved execution findings rather than reasons to guess.

review_improvement: Restores exact single-sensor raw coverage, makes availability/status an interpretation gate and requires the matched SDR for conversion instead of accepting any numeric-looking output.
independent_technical_reasoning: Get Sensor Reading combines a raw value with scanning, availability and event-state information. A raw byte from the wrong sensor or converted with another SDR can look plausible, while an unavailable reading must not be treated as zero or healthy. The source's one-sensor identity and complete raw response are therefore essential; wildcard high-level output is broader but weaker evidence.
